escenas.texto: Which was the most viewed video in Europe this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, Querían Habitaciones Distintas… y Terminaron…, by YoSoyDander, with over 15 million views.
In second place, Is This The Best Way To Recycle Plastic? 🧐, by crafter duck - DIY, with over 20 million views.
And number one: 2026 Ballon d'Or | Red Carpet Pre Show, by DAZN Football, with over 21 million views.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
